themes.name: Judgment That Won't Compile
themes.plain: Some of the hardest calls depend on meaning, context, and implied claims, and no rule set captures that. The models keep concluding that judgment can only be narrowed to a smaller, safer box, not automated away.
themes.evidence: All three models on generative content review say legal and brand risk turns on subtle phrasing and context that software cannot defend in an audit, and the semantic context layer answers make the same point about words like customer meaning different things to different teams.

themes.name: Chokepoint Before Trust
themes.plain: When the models cannot trust who is acting or what a tool will do, they build one door they own and force everything through it. Gateway, proxy, log, spending cap, kill switch, because a sent message or a spent ad budget cannot be taken back.
themes.evidence: Both rounds on safe agent execution converge on a broker, gateway, or proxy in front of every write with hard spend and audience caps, and the content review answers apply the same logic by locking copy to a registry of approved claims.

themes.name: Nobody Can Verify Downstream
themes.plain: Once data, an instruction, an ad budget, or a brand mention leaves your own systems, you cannot see inside the partner, ad platform, or model that received it. Safety, compliance, and effect can only be estimated from outside, never proven.
themes.evidence: The consent and deletion answers say you cannot inspect an ad platform audience or a trained model, the agent execution answers say vendor APIs never expose their effects or offer rollback, and the answer engine work says retrieval is hidden.

themes.name: No Ground Truth to Measure Against
themes.plain: Several problems have no reliable answer key to check work against. What is being measured shifts while you measure it, is personalized per person, or was never labeled, so teams end up estimating a range instead of reading a number.
themes.evidence: The answer engine and incrementality answers both say the system changes its own behavior while you study it, identity resolution lacks representative ground truth, and content review lacks a defensible line for when phrasing breaks a claim.

themes.name: Start From What Already Failed
themes.plain: Almost no answer begins with a blueprint for the ideal system. They begin with evidence the company already has: rejected work, real traffic logs, one live case, verbatim answers.
themes.evidence: Today all three models open on generative content review by pulling hundreds of past legal rejections and approvals, echoing earlier first moves that mined network and vendor logs for where data leaves and ran real agents against the site to get labeled sessions.
